correctness.rationale: Each exact soft-threshold branch f± is q-Lipschitz with 0<q=1−ah<1, so backward coupling ensures a unique invariant law. Its images of I=[−B,B] overlap and cover I iff q≥1/2. For q<1/2 both branches are affine with strong separation, giving a nonatomic Cantor law of dimension log2/(−log q). At q=1/2 they halve I, giving exact uniform measure. For q>1/2 an arbitrary small plateau preimage can be hit by a common finite sign word from all x∈I, using a cylinder of diameter ≤2Bq^n; the uniform atom minorization yields TV geometric contraction. Stationarity and propagation of a reset atom give a dense countable purely atomic support. Finite-support laws from a deterministic start are TV singular to the nonatomic invariant laws. Independently checked exact rational endpoint geometry and a five-sign global reset word.
residual_risks: Claims rely on exact scalar fair Bernoulli innovations and exact real soft threshold, not general stochastic optimization.
